posts.title: $NVDA Jensen Huang on photonics: adding scale-up to optical domain, “is going to be, well, 15x” to aggregate volume. Relating to $LITE, $COHR, and laser companies.. “I'm fairly certain the amount of optics that we need in the future will be several orders of magnitude” Huang added. We’re already in a CW laser bottleneck, but given the time/rate for capacity expansion, I definitely don’t see it meeting the scale Jensen envisions… Your leading merchant suppliers focusing new capacity toward UHP CPO lasers might also unintentionally make shortages around lower end ranges more severe… Since even if you don’t reallocate capacity (which Coherent implied they’d do to maximize margins), the demand for lower end ranges increase too as pluggable demand grows. Anyway, you’re gonna need a lot of lasers and given low BOM cost… this might trigger some fun game theory allocation wars + price hikes for supply

2003 年 3 月 10 日，美国加州帕萨迪纳市议会开特别会议。帕萨迪纳在洛杉矶旁边，是加州理工学院所在的城市。公众发言环节，一个穿灰 T 恤的大学生走到话筒前： “我叫 Dario Amodei，是加州理工学院的大二学生。” 他带来一份反对伊拉克战争的请愿书。上周四递交时，有 400 名加州理工师生签名，到这天已经接近 600 人。他当场把请愿书念了一遍，其中一句是： “我们创造推动这个国家前进的技术，看到它被不加区分地用于战争，深感痛心。” 发言最后，他说：“请不要扼杀和平而激动人心的科学——它为这座城市带来就业，为全人类带来进步。” 10 天后，伊拉克战争爆发。18 年后，他和几位前 OpenAI 同事联合创办了 Anthropic。 20 岁时他担心的，是自己这代人做出的技术被拿去打仗。现在他整天担心的是 AI 被利用。 这段 2 分钟的发言出自帕萨迪纳市政府存档的会议录像，我加了中英双语字幕，可以对照着看。 线索：X 用户 @dummerspast39 原始录像：https://t.co/BhN2IM7HVi（2003 年 3 月 10 日市议会特别会议）

SemiAnalysis〈擴束光學（EBO）連接器：安裝維護優勢與 ECOC 動態〉 1、背景：人工智慧叢集光互連擴張後，光纖安裝與維護難度上升；EBO（Expanded Beam Optical）以擴束跨越氣隙、端面不實體接觸。 2、優點： 1）對灰塵較不敏感，減少清潔與檢測，節省安裝人力。 2）低插接力有助提高連接器密度。 3）最大價值在維護：維修更快、停機更少。 3、限制與並存：EBO 插入損耗高於 MMC，光預算緊時 MMC 較有利；標準連接器目前成本較低。預期 EBO 與 MMC 將依密度、可維修性、光預算並存。 4、營收時程提醒：布線加速不必然提早營收；機櫃分批到貨、並行施工與開通驗證仍耗時，人力節省對「營收時程」的影響視部署而定。 5、ECOC 動態：Senko 展示以 EBO 為基礎的 XBO 光背板連接器，可自動斷開與重新對接，指向減少人工插拔；影片演示按鍵後完成第 400 次自動插拔循環，機箱標示「Co-Packaged Optics at Scale」。採用仍取決於系統設計與認證。

posts.title: Our base case is that TCEQ resumes in December once ERCOT delivers its Dec 10 report, so the phases needing permits soon slip about a quarter and the rest of our forecast holds. Which campuses, phases and MW are exposed is in the Datacenter Industry Model. sales@semianalysis.com (5/5)

Because an air permit only gates the power plant, site work and any generation already permitted keep moving during the hold, so a three-month pause on issuance only becomes a delivery delay for a campus that has to start building its plant before the review ends. (4/5)

That 8.7GW is campus size rather than what gets delayed, since three of the six already have a first tranche of generation permitted and are only waiting on the expansion permit, while one has filed and is waiting and the other two haven’t filed anything yet. (3/5)

The directive matters because Abbott’s August pause only covered grid interconnections, so campuses building their own generation behind the meter were untouched and on-site power became the workaround, whereas TCEQ now confirms the freeze covers their air permits too. (2/5)

We looked at each Texas site planning on-site power that falls under Governor Abbott’s Sept 21 directive, which tells TCEQ to stop issuing any permit tied to a datacenter until ERCOT finishes its review, and found six campuses, 8.7GW in all, needing air permits during the pause. (1/5)🧵

posts.title: The internet is getting to experience what Crypto has had to endure for a decade. Crypto just like all online businesses is built on code. For the last decade the only reason Crypto was targeted was unit economics. In short, large hacking groups operate like a business, on risk/reward. „it’s going to take us an average of $20k with a winrate of 10% to find an exploit, but the reward is a clear $10 million“ Over time the expected value pays off and the transparency Crypto provided in regards to the payoff made it a massive target. Furthermore the transparency of the technology made it a global target, with tens of thousands and years of defense to protect against attacks. The unit economics have now shifted. Each passing quarter, the cost to hack is decreasing exponentially and thus the balance between cost * win rate against the payoff is changing. Expected Value= (Win Rate * Average Win )-(Loss Rate * Average Loss}) In short, each passing day, the expected value ratio between going for Crypto vs the old tech stack is shifting. Hacking/exploiting crypto, that has played defense as one of its core missions, is becoming increasingly harder to do then attacking the regular online worl
